item.title: Actually Additions
item.creator: A30x1
item.description:
A long-time fan favorite, Use the Atomic Reconstructor and the Empowerer to turn minerals into powerful crystals that allow the creation of useful machines for processing and sorting items, lasers for wireless energy transporting, items and fluids, renewable oil to generate power, and much more.

- Official Bedrock port of Actually Additions Java Mod

faqEntries.heading: How do I get the guidebook back if I lose it?
faqEntries.content: Each player receives the Actually Additions Manual on their first spawn. If you lose it, you can craft another one on a crafting table with 1 Paper and 1 Canola Seeds. It is your main in-game reference for every recipe and mechanic.

faqEntries.heading: What is CF?
faqEntries.content: CF stands for Crystal Flux, the energy system this add-on uses. Machines need CF to run, generators produce it, and Laser Relays move it between machines.

faqEntries.heading: Why isn't my machine working?
faqEntries.content: The most common reason is no energy. Make sure a generator is producing CF and that the machine either stores its own CF or is connected through Energy Laser Relays.

faqEntries.heading: How do I connect Laser Relays?
faqEntries.content: Place the relays near your machines and use the Laser Wrench to link them into a network.

faqEntries.heading: Where do I find Black Quartz?
faqEntries.content: Black Quartz Ore generates underground in the Overworld. It is used to craft the Iron Casing, which is needed to build the Atomic Reconstructor and other machines.

faqEntries.heading: Where do the crystals come from?
faqEntries.content: You create them with the Atomic Reconstructor using the correct Lens and inputs, then upgrade them into Empowered crystals with the Empowerer.

howToEntries.heading: Getting started
howToEntries.content: When you first enter the world, you automatically receive the Actually Additions Manual. If you ever lose it, craft another with 1 Paper and 1 Canola Seeds on a crafting table. Hold it and interact to open it, then navigate by looking at the on-page buttons. The manual has a page for every block and item, and it is your main reference for recipes and mechanics. To close it, press Sneak or click the X button in the top-right corner. Inside the manual there is a settings screen where you can adjust the cursor sensitivity and the interface scale.

howToEntries.heading: Getting energy (Crystal Flux)
howToEntries.content: Everything in this add-on runs on Crystal Flux (CF). To produce it, craft and place a generator such as the Coal Generator (burns coal and other solid fuels), Oil Generator (burns canola oils), Leaf-Eating Generator, Bio Reactor, or Heat Collector (placed next to lava). Machines store their own CF.

howToEntries.heading: Moving energy around
howToEntries.content: To share CF between machines, place Energy Laser Relays next to them and link the relays with the Laser Wrench. There are basic, advanced, and extreme tiers with higher transfer rates. Item and Fluid Laser Relays move items and fluids the same way.

howToEntries.heading: Getting started with machines
howToEntries.content: Craft the Iron Casing using Black Quartz, then use it to build the Atomic Reconstructor, the core machine of the add-on. Give it Crystal Flux from a generator and it fires a beam that converts items placed in front of it into new ones, including the six crystals when you add the matching Lens.

howToEntries.heading: Upgrading crystals
howToEntries.content: Build the Empowerer with Display Stands around it, place the crystal and the catalyst items on the stands, and supply energy to turn a crystal into its Empowered version.

howToEntries.heading: Farming and processing
howToEntries.content: Use the Farmer and Greenhouse Glass to automate crops (Canola, Rice, Flax, Coffee). Use the Crusher and Double Crusher to grind materials, and the Powered Furnace to smelt with CF instead of fuel.
